info.name: AppScreener DAST - ZAP auth/discovery testbed with unified coverage
info.description: Quick checkAuth regression calls and full DAST scans for FORM, BROWSER, Basic, Digest, bearer token, custom headers, NTLM, and Kerberos authentication, and custom HTTP Sender scripts. Unified /__testbed/expected, /__testbed/coverage and protected reset controls are available for all testbed applications. Includes a mutual-TLS client-certificate scan target using multipart certificate/clientCertificatePassword/clientCertificateIndex fields.
